title: Whole genome sequencing of the influenza A virus was carried out in Turkmenistan with the participation of the WHO mission - Turkmenportal.com

analysis.time: The event occurred in February 2023, and the report was published on July 14, 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: Turkmenistan, specifically involving the Virological Reference Laboratory (VRL) of the Center for Public Health and Nutrition and the State Service for Health and Nutrition.
analysis.event: A WHO technical advisory mission, led by Artem Fadeev, conducted whole genome sequencing of the influenza A virus in Turkmenistan as part of the Pandemic Influenza Preparedness Framework (PIP).
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: For the first time, whole genome sequencing was performed on 10 samples of the influenza A virus subtype H3N2. The sequenced viruses were uploaded to GISAID, marking the country's first successful experience in this area.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The mission successfully completed training on Next-Generation Sequencing and phylogenetic analysis. The data has been uploaded to GISAID, and the initiative is part of a broader framework to strengthen national capacity.

analysis.brief_en: In February 2023, a WHO technical advisory mission led by Artem Fadeev visited Turkmenistan to strengthen national capacity in influenza virus sequencing. The mission included training at the Virological Reference Laboratory on Next-Generation Sequencing and phylogenetic analysis. For the first time, whole genome sequencing was performed on 10 samples of the influenza A virus subtype H3N2, with the data uploaded to GISAID. This initiative, conducted under the Pandemic Influenza Preparedness Framework, marks Turkmenistan's first successful experience in this field.

This initiative, conducted under the Pandemic Influenza Preparedness Framework, marks Turkmenistan's first successful experience in this field.
